hypothesis: Raising the relative-strength floor from the broad VCP default of 85 to 90 should restrict purchases to clearer market leaders; in the development candidate set this retained 63 of 98 gated setups and improved 20-day mean return and large-winner incidence.
trial_note: Only the relative-strength entry floor changes relative to the stop5 protocol. Exit rules, costs, slots, stock universe and the development interval remain frozen.
